audience: store operators who manage orders, stock and customers in EasyStore

useCases.title: Review paid orders waiting to ship
useCases.text: Find paid, unfulfilled orders and inspect their items and shipment history before planning the next dispatch.

useCases.title: Check variant stock across locations
useCases.text: Find a product and its variants, then compare available, committed, incoming and reserved stock at each location.

useCases.title: Reconcile stock after a physical count
useCases.text: Review a variant’s stock at the selected location and set its quantity to the confirmed physical count when requested.

useCases.title: Find a customer and review recent orders
useCases.text: Look up a customer by email or phone, then review their orders and shipment details to prepare a support reply.
